problems: Channel logic reuses the CASE from public.london_daily_covers_base (read this run via pg_get_viewdef): 'web' = Booking Widget, any '%landing page%', Nav CTA, Hero CTA, Menu Page, Website, 'PPC%', popup, edm; 'gr' = Google Reserve Integration; 'walk' = Walk In; 'recep' = '%reception%' or DSL Host, plus 'Reservation Team' / 'Reservations Team' (the USA reservations desks). The 'ot' slot is the USA platform: Open Table, OpenTable, OTGC, OT Guestcenter, OT and Resy. Filters: is_deleted = false, status_simple <> 'Canceled', venue_seating_area_name NOT ILIKE '%bar%', date = (sr_created_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date.

Staff-name booking sources are EXCLUDED from the covers total entirely, as in prior weeks: the view's two-capitalised-words regex, plus the lower-case and single-name USA staff entries ('andrew sicklin', 'Luz', 'Lucilly', 'Tracey', 'Wendy') and 'Imported Reservations'. 'Flaming Duck Miami' matches the staff regex but is a partner source, so it stays in 'tp' with DoorDash and Bilt Integration.

VALIDATION: 14 to 20 Sep recomputed with this SQL returns Aqua NYC 1,686 (published 1,714, -1.6%), Hutong NYC 1,295 (1,325, -2.3%), Hutong Miami 602 (627, -4.0%), market 3,583 vs 3,666 published (-2.3%). All of the gap is cancellations booked in that week and cancelled since. Trend weeks W31 to W36 reproduce last week's published series within 0.7%. One classification difference: last week put Hutong Miami's 'Lucilly' bookings (14 covers) in 'recep'; this run treats that name as staff and excludes it, so Miami 'recep' is 0.
